text: dsh-pet-progress 是 DSH 网页宠物的进度伴侣，通过读取会话中的 todo/write、goal/change 及活动事件，把任务完成比例、目标轮次或当前活动显示为宠物状态气泡。进行中时展示任务名称与完成数；目标阻塞、暂停或完成时显示相应状态；没有任务清单时可显示模型输出或工具活动摘要。宠物面板的“进度”按钮可将完整任务列表写入 DSH 日志。适合希望在网页宠物上查看长任务进展的 DSH 用户，需要安装 dsh-pet；无需额外密钥或外部服务。

dsh-pet-progress displays DSH todo and goal progress on the web pet, including completion, active tasks, goal rounds, and blocked or finished states. Without a plan, it shows model or tool activity. The pet panel writes the full todo list to the DSH log. Requires dsh-pet; no extra key or service.
想在网页宠物上看到 DSH 长任务完成了多少
能不能把 todo 清单进度显示成宠物气泡？
让桌面宠物展示当前目标进行到第几轮
没有任务列表时，也想看模型正在处理什么
Show my DSH todo completion on the web pet.
Display goal progress and current activity in the pet bubble.
dsh-pet-progress 的功能「会话任务进度气泡」：监听 todo/write 事件，将完成数、百分比和进行中的任务名称折算为单行气泡；全部完成时显示一次性完成提示。
dsh-pet-progress 的功能「目标进度与状态」：读取 goal/change 快照，按目标轮次显示进展，并呈现暂停、阻塞原因或目标完成状态。
dsh-pet-progress 的功能「活动摘要与完整清单」：没有有效 todo 或目标时汇总模型输出、阶段或工具用途；点击宠物面板“进度”操作，将完整任务清单写入 DSH 日志。
dsh-pet-progress 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 22 天；提交数 12；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-pet-progress README · dsh-pet-progress：**English** · [中文说明](README.zh.md)

**A progress bar for your desktop pet.**

The [dsh web pet](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-pet) shows what the agent
is doing *right now* — thinking, calling a tool, done. It has no way to show how
much of a long task is finished, so a task that is 90% done looks exactly like
one that just started.

dsh-pet-progress README · dsh-pet-progress：This plugin fixes that. It reads the todo lists and goals your agent already
writes to the session, and folds them into a percentage bubble on the pet.
A session that never writes a todo list isn't left blank either — there the
bubble falls back to a plain line saying what is happening right now.

dsh-pet-progress README · Install：One command, using the plugin's full GitHub URL:

```bash
dsh plugin add https://github.com/Elefseus/dsh-pet-progress
```

This requires the [dsh web pet](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-pet) to be
installed. If it is missing, the plugin stays loaded but publishes nothing —
you'll see a note in the dsh log rather than a crash.

dsh-pet-progress README · Install：**Restart DSH afterwards** — bundles are read only at startup, so the plugin
won't mount until you do. The bubble then appears on its own the next time your
agent writes a todo list or starts a goal; there is nothing to switch on.

For a named profile, use `dsh plugin --profile <name> add …`.
dsh-pet-progress README · What you'll see：A small bubble above the pet, updated whenever the todo list or the goal changes:

dsh-pet-progress README · What you'll see：| Situation | Bubble |
| --- | --- |
| Todo list, one task in progress | `3/7 · 43%` titled with that task |
| Todo list, several tasks in progress | `3/7 · 43%`, naming them — up to three, `+N` for the rest |
| All todos done | `任务全部完成` in green — a moment, gone after about 10 seconds |
| Long-lived goal with no todos | `2/8 轮` — the goal's round budget |
| Goal finished | `目标完成` in green — also a moment |
| Goal blocked | The block reason, in place of progress |
| No todo list and no goal | A plain line with no percentage — what the model is thinking (`正在思考`), the words it is writing (`最近输出`), or what the tool it just called is for (`当前过程`) |

dsh-pet-progress README · What you'll see：A standing bubble fades out about 30 seconds after the last progress update, so a
finished turn doesn't leave a stale percentage on screen; it comes back by itself
if the work resumes. A **moment** — a finished list or a finished goal — is
announced once and never renewed, so it clears itself instead of sitting there;
it also keeps the bubble for those ten seconds, because the agent usually starts
talking again immediately and would otherwise replace it before you read it.

dsh-pet-progress README · What you'll see：Several sessions can be open at once — the most recently active one owns the
bubble.

dsh-pet-progress README · Checking the full list：The bubble is one line, so there's a button for the rest: click **进度** on the
pet panel and the complete todo list is written to the dsh log.

dsh-pet-progress README · Good to know：- **It never over-reports.** A todo whose status the plugin doesn't recognise
  counts as *not done*. If every entry in a write is unreadable, the plugin
  treats it as "no information" and keeps what it had.
- **It won't guess.** It names the tasks that are actually in progress — up to
  three, each trimmed to 32 characters, with `+N` when more are running. It never
  picks one of several and pretends that one is the work.
- **It reads, it doesn't judge.** A percentage comes from the todo lists and
  goals your agent writes; the plugin never infers progress from how long
  something has been running. Without either, it shows the plain activity line
  instead of a number.
- **It says what is happening, not just which phase.** With no task list it
  follows the model's own words as they stream — the thinking first, then the
  answer, newest words only, since those are the ones that say what is going on
  now — and it names what a tool call is *for* (`正在调用 pwsh：npm test`,
  `正在调用 read：progress.ts`), not only that a tool is running.

dsh-pet-progress README · Requirements：| | |
| --- | --- |
| DSH | `>=0.1.7-rc.1` |
| `@linxin666/dsh-pet` | `>=0.4.0` (peer) |
| Node | `^22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0` |

The plugin binds to the pet's plugin-seam contract (`announce`,
`registerPanelAction`, and the `session/event` channel); an older pet does not
expose all three.

dsh-pet-progress README · Configuration：```ts
apply(ctx, { enabled?: boolean, heartbeatMs?: number })
```

With `enabled: false` nothing mounts. `heartbeatMs` defaults to `10000`.

dsh-pet-progress README · Using it from code：The plugin is host-only (no client bundle). The pet service is available as
`ctx.pet`, and the same three seams the pet publishes are what this plugin uses:

| Seam | Used for |
| --- | --- |
| `ctx.on('session/event', …)` | Reading `todo/write`, `goal/change`, and the turn/step/tool/message events behind the activity line |
| `ctx.pet.announce(…)` | Publishing the progress bubble |
| `ctx.pet.registerPanelAction(…)` | The `进度` panel button |

dsh-pet-progress README · Using it from code：Adjust `PROGRESS_TTL_MS` and `MAX_TRACKED_SESSIONS` in
[`src/progress.ts`](src/progress.ts) to change the fade-out and how many sessions
are tracked at once.

dsh-pet-progress README · Development：`src/*.ts` is the source of truth; `lib/` is committed build output, because the
cordis loader does no transpilation. **After editing `src/`, rebuild and commit
`lib/` with it — CI fails if the two drift apart.**

```bash
node build.mjs              # rebuild lib/ from src/
node --test src/*.test.ts   # 76 tests, node:test only
```

To work on the code, skip installing and point the profile at your checkout:

dsh-pet-progress README · Development：```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop up dsh-pet-progress          # update to latest default branch
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "<repo>#<tag>"           # pin a tag instead (reproducible)
```

dsh-pet-progress README · More：- [Design notes](docs/DESIGN.md) — why the plugin is built this way: the event
  gap it fills, why it's a sibling rather than a patch, what it reports, and the
  two non-obvious details (deferred mounting, and an announcement slot with no
  retract).
